div.swb-settings [aria-label="Silverware Toolbar settings" aria-modal="true" role="dialog" tabindex="-1"]
p.swb-settings-subtitle "For every page in the space: SilverBullet's configuration"

span.swb-settings-hint "It shows over the keyboard too: the docked toolbar goes over it. Turned off here, on this device, at once (SilverBullet's command Editor: Toggle Keyboard Bar turns it on again)."
span.swb-settings-hint "As SilverBullet writes keys (Ctrl-Shift-q, Alt-k); with nothing selected it shows the toolbar at the cursor. Applies after a reload."
span.swb-settings-name "A word at the cursor as if selected"

span.swb-settings-hint "With nothing selected, Bold (any inline format) and Clear formatting work on the word the cursor is in or touches: what spaces separate, without the punctuation at its ends (a period, a comma, quotes). The cursor stays where it was."
button.swb-settings-toolbar-tab [aria-checked="false" aria-label="Test, used for Click" data-swb-toolbar="0" role="radio" type="button"]
button.swb-settings-toolbar-tab [aria-checked="true" aria-label="Test touch, used for Touch" data-swb-toolbar="1" role="radio" type="button"]
button.swb-settings-look-show.swb-settings-toolbar-use [aria-pressed="false" data-swb-use="click" title="Show this toolbar for Click (in place of Test)" type="button"] "Click"
button.swb-settings-look-show.swb-settings-toolbar-use [aria-pressed="true" data-swb-use="touch" title="Touch shows this toolbar: pick another for Touch to change it" type="button"] "Touch"
p.swb-settings-intro "Click an item to change how it shows. Drag items and rows to reorder them (by finger, hold an item a moment first)."
button.swb-settings-row-grip [aria-label="Move row 1 (drag, or Alt+↑ ↓)" title="Move row 1 (drag, or Alt+↑ ↓)" type="button"]

div.swb-settings-items.swb-settings-zone-left [aria-label="Row 1, pinned left" data-swb-items="0" data-swb-zone="left" role="list" title="At the left end of this row's line where the toolbar is docked, out of what scrolls"]

div.swb-settings-items.swb-settings-zone-right [aria-label="Row 1, pinned right" data-swb-items="0" data-swb-zone="right" role="list" title="At the right end of this row's line where the toolbar is docked, out of what scrolls"]
div.swb-settings-item [aria-expanded="false" aria-label="Turn into, row 1, item 1" data-swb-item="0:0" role="listitem" tabindex="0"]
button.swb-settings-remove [aria-label="Remove Turn into" title="Remove Turn into" type="button"]
button.swb-settings-row-grip [aria-label="Move row 2 (drag, or Alt+↑ ↓)" title="Move row 2 (drag, or Alt+↑ ↓)" type="button"]

div.swb-settings-items.swb-settings-zone-left [aria-label="Row 2, pinned left" data-swb-items="1" data-swb-zone="left" role="list" title="At the left end of this row's line where the toolbar is docked, out of what scrolls"]

div.swb-settings-items.swb-settings-zone-right [aria-label="Row 2, pinned right" data-swb-items="1" data-swb-zone="right" role="list" title="At the right end of this row's line where the toolbar is docked, out of what scrolls"]
div.swb-settings-iconly.swb-settings-item [aria-expanded="false" aria-label="Bold, row 2, item 1" data-swb-item="1:0" role="listitem" tabindex="0" title="Bold"]
div.swb-settings-iconly.swb-settings-item [aria-expanded="false" aria-label="Italic, row 2, item 2" data-swb-item="1:1" role="listitem" tabindex="0" title="Italic"]
div.swb-settings-iconly.swb-settings-item [aria-expanded="false" aria-label="Code, row 2, item 3" data-swb-item="1:2" role="listitem" tabindex="0" title="Code"]
div.swb-settings-iconly.swb-settings-item.swb-settings-separator [aria-label="Separator, row 2, item 4" data-swb-item="1:3" role="listitem" tabindex="0" title="Separator"]
div.swb-settings-iconly.swb-settings-item [aria-expanded="false" aria-label="Link, row 2, item 5" data-swb-item="1:4" role="listitem" tabindex="0" title="Link"]
div.swb-settings-iconly.swb-settings-item [aria-expanded="false" aria-label="Highlight, row 2, item 6" data-swb-item="1:5" role="listitem" tabindex="0" title="Highlight"]
div.swb-settings-iconly.swb-settings-item.swb-settings-separator [aria-label="Separator, row 2, item 7" data-swb-item="1:6" role="listitem" tabindex="0" title="Separator"]
div.swb-settings-iconly.swb-settings-item [aria-expanded="false" aria-label="Every action, row 2, item 8" data-swb-item="1:7" role="listitem" tabindex="0" title="Every action"]
button.swb-settings-remove [aria-label="Remove Every action" title="Remove Every action" type="button"]
span.swb-settings-hint "Bold, italic, strikethrough, highlight, code, links and wiki links."
span.swb-settings-hint "Turn lines into a paragraph, a heading, a list, a task or a quote."
span.swb-settings-hint "Remove the inline formats of the selection."
span.swb-settings-hint "Every SilverBullet command, found by typing its name in the list of every action, and as a favourite."
span.swb-settings-hint "An action opening SilverBullet's slash commands at the cursor, as typing / does (a phone's keyboard has / a page away)."
span.swb-settings-hint "On a phone or tablet: an action hiding the on-screen keyboard, the selection kept as it is (to see more of the page while you format it)."
span.swb-settings-hint "A gesture button among the favourites: two actions in one, a click runs the first, swiping it up the second."

span.swb-settings-hint "A text snippet among the favourites: a button of your own character (an emoji too) and label writing your text at the cursor, {s} in it the text selected, {c} where the cursor goes."
span.swb-settings-hint "An action picking an emoji to write at the cursor, found by its name and keywords."
